name: Accordion
description: The first clip folds up like pleated paper toward one side while the second unfolds out of the other, in 3D with lit and shaded pleats. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: pleats
params.description: Number of pleats in each clip

params.name: direction
params.description: Direction the clips move, snapped to its main axis (x right, y up)

params.name: shading
params.description: Contrast between the lit and shaded panels
